'''Fairouz Ai''' (Japanese: '''ファイルーズあい''' ''Fairouz Ai''), born '''Fairouz Ai Kadota''' (Japanese: '''門田ファイルーズあい''' ''Kadota Fairouz Ai'')<ref>https://twitter.com/MonthlyChampion/status/910726232223789057</ref> on July 6, 1993,<ref name=RaccoonDog>[https://web.archive.org/web/20250322150905/https://raccoon-dog.co.jp/talent/r12-fai.html Fairouz Ai's talent profile on Raccoon Dog] (archived March 22, 2025).</ref> is a Japanese voice actress.

==Biography==
Fairouz Ai was born in Tokyo on July 6, 1993.<ref name=RaccoonDog/> She is of Japanese descent from her mother's side and of Egyptian descent from her father's side. During fifth grade in elementary school up to her graduation, she lived in {{wp|Cairo}}, Egypt, although she resides in Japan for most of her life.<ref name=Newtype>(July 2, 2019). [https://webnewtype.com/report/cast/195840.html 「ダンベル何キロ持てる？」ファイルーズあいインタビュー「筋トレで鍛えた腹筋で、もっといい声でもっといい芝居ができるよう、頑張りマスキュラー！」] Newtype (Japanese).</ref>

Fairouz Ai read and became a fan of ''{{wp|JoJo's Bizarre Adventure}}'' during her middle school years, and she would engage in reading sessions over {{wp|Skype}} with other ''JoJo'' fans. This inspired her to strive for a career as a voice actress.<ref name=Newtype/> She made her major voice acting debut as Hibiki Sakura in the ''{{wp|How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?}}'' anime adaptation, which was released in 2019. In 2021, she was cast as {{wp|Jolyne Cujoh}} for the anime adaptation of ''{{wp|JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean}}'', the story's sixth part.

On December 31, 2024, it was announced that Fairouz Ai would be limiting her work activities due to being diagnosed with {{wp|post-traumatic stress disorder}} (PTSD).<ref>(December 31, 2024) [https://www.raccoon-dog.co.jp/info/20241231.html 弊社所属「ファイルーズあい」に関するご報告] ''Raccoon Dog''.</ref> She fully resumed her activities on April 1, 2025.<ref>[https://twitter.com/fairouzzzzzz/status/1906905637721874604 Tweet] by ファイルーズあい 🦋 Fairouz Ai (@fairouzzzzzz). Posted on April 1, 2025.</ref>

As of April 1, 2025, Fairouz Ai is currently affiliated with the talent agency Mausu Promotion. She had been part of the talent agency Raccoon Dog from 2022 to 2025.<ref>(March 31, 2025). [https://www.raccoon-dog.co.jp/info/20250331.html ファイルーズあい　退所のお知らせ] ''Raccoon Dog''.</ref>

==Personal life==
Fairouz Ai's hobbies include drawing, watching horror movies, strength training, and fashion. She is fluent in Arabic.<ref name=RaccoonDog/> Her brother is Gihado Kadota (Japanese: '''門田 ギハード''' ''Kadota Gihādo''), a professional ice climber.<ref>[https://twitter.com/GihadoKadota/status/1146223345861402624 Tweet] by 門田 ギハード (@GihadoKadota). Posted on July 3, 2019.</ref>
